articles.summary: REDWOOD CITY, Calif., March 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Coherus Oncology, Inc. (Nasdaq: CHRS), today announced that its full year and fourth quarter 2025 financial results will be released after market close on Monday, March 9, 2026. Starting at 4:30 p.m.
articles.title: Coherus Oncology to Report Full Year and Fourth Quarter 2025 Financial Results on March 9, 2026

articles.summary: – LOQTORZI ® net revenue more than doubled to $40.8 million in 2025 from $19.1 million in 2024 – – Reduced secured and convertible debt by 90% from $480 million to $38.8 million over 2024-2025 – – $172.1 million in year ending cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities – – Conference call
articles.title: Coherus Oncology Reports Full Year and Fourth Quarter 2025 Financial Results and Provides Business Update
